content.descriptor: Korean developer of small-molecule candidates for atherosclerosis and Alzheimer’s disease.
about: AgingTarget Inc. is a Korean company developing small-molecule drug candidates. According to the company as of 5 October 2026, its two research programs address atherosclerosis through vascular ageing and Alzheimer’s disease.

The company places both candidates before the preclinical stage. This is the company’s statement, not an assessment by Teranova; the profile contains no efficacy claims or comparisons with approved medicines.
